models.name: Void Demon Stalker Creature
models.creator: Pigcraft

license.label: CC Attribution
license.requirements: Author must be credited. Commercial use is allowed.

models.description: A terrifying horror creature with an extremely tall and thin body, designed with unnaturally long limbs that almost touch the ground. Its arms end in massive razor claws, while its skin appears like stretched dark leather pulled tightly over sharp bones. The head is nearly faceless except for a giant vertical mouth filled with needle-like teeth. Dark shadow-like liquid drips across parts of its body like black venom, while long blade-shaped bone spikes grow from its back. Standing in a neutral pose, the creature radiates an aggressive and deeply unsettling presence, perfect for horror or dark fantasy scenes.
models.label: Void Demon
models.suggestedTeaserUse: Dark skin, a long jaw and a hunched silhouette. A sideways glimpse of the mouth and claws would be enough to suggest something dangerous.

models.name: Tall Fast Horror Monster with Long Claws
models.creator: Pigcraft

license.label: CC Attribution
license.requirements: Author must be credited. Commercial use is allowed.

models.description: An extremely slender and energetic horror creature with unnaturally long arms, legs, and neck. Its small head has leathery, wrinkled dark gray skin, tiny glowing white eyes, and a wide, grotesque grin full of sharp teeth. Hands and feet end in overlong, unnaturally extended claws. Prowling in a silent, stalking posture, it exudes an eerie and menacing presence. Ideal for horror, dark fantasy, or thriller games and cinematic scenes.
models.label: Tall Fast Horror
models.suggestedTeaserUse: One of your original linked choices. A low stalking pose, large claws and a ridged head. Could briefly lean into a distant corridor before retreating.

models.name: Nightmarish Shadow Horror
models.creator: Pigcraft

license.label: CC Attribution
license.requirements: Author must be credited. Commercial use is allowed.

models.description: A terrifying humanoid with a featureless, smooth black face and unnervingly muscular, thin body. Its oily, light-absorbing skin and unnaturally elongated limbs end in sharp claws that scrape and click against surfaces. Movements are creepily fluid, evoking pure dread, with eyes and mouth appearing only when hunting. Clawed, hybrid feet of bone and skin feature raised heels and flexible toes, allowing silent glides, wall-climbing, and ambush attacks. Perfect for horror games, dark fantasy scenes, or cinematic nightmare creatures.
models.label: Nightmarish Shadow
models.suggestedTeaserUse: A dark humanoid face with hollow-looking eyes. Best for a slow face reveal from the edge of a doorway, with most of its body hidden.
